name: event-from-notes
query: Create our printmaking workshop plan in Notion from the notes. Draft the invitation and run sheet; do not send anything.

context.conversation: December 12, 2026, 14:00–17:00 America/New_York; 24 guests; $900 budget. Maya coordinates, Jules handles materials. Room hold expires Nov20; booking and price unconfirmed. Materials estimated $180. Materials list due Nov23. RSVP deadline Dec5. No guest names. Invitations depend on room confirmation. No destination supplied.

search_routes.intent: Find an existing workshop plan or tracker

success_criteria: Creates a private plan without asking for destination or repeated context; no outline/row approval gate.
Saves a usable invitation draft and proposed timed run sheet, not empty headings or writing instructions.
Preserves unconfirmed booking, unknown room/refreshment costs and unknown owners; does not assign fictional people or calculate misleading remaining budget.
Separates guest data from preparations, creates no fabricated guests, and sends or shares nothing.
Connects records to the plan, retains undated tasks, and makes the booking decision and its real deadline clear on the rendered home.
